description: This file implements a TCP container object for the ANSC (Advanced Networking Service Container) framework. It includes functions for creating, initializing, enrolling associated objects, and removing the TCP object. The file defines the core lifecycle methods of the object, as well as setup for associated server and worker components related to TCP networking within the module.

methods.name: ANSC_HANDLE AnscLpccoTcpCreate(ANSC_HANDLE hContainerContext,ANSC_HANDLE hOwnerContext,ANSC_HANDLE hAnscReserved)
methods.description: Constructs and initializes an instance of the Ansc Lpcco Tcp Object, setting core function pointers and attributes.

methods.name: ANSC_STATUS AnscLpccoTcpRemove(ANSC_HANDLE hThisObject)
methods.description: Destroys the TCP object and associated resources, including server and worker sub-objects.

methods.name: ANSC_STATUS AnscLpccoTcpEnrollObjects(ANSC_HANDLE hThisObject)
methods.description: Enrols sub-objects such as daemon and broker servers and workers, and sets IMC interface functions.

methods.name: ANSC_STATUS AnscLpccoTcpInitialize(ANSC_HANDLE hThisObject)
methods.description: Initializes the TCP object, setting default values for network addresses, ports, message sizes, and function pointers.
